 Follow Rory Culkin shares 'silver lining' of being 'locked in closets' by his siblings
 Erin Jensen, USA TODAY Fri, October 30, 2026 at 1:01 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. In Apple TV's new thriller series, "Nocturne," Rory Culkin plays a nurse assigned to an infamous serial killer placed in solitary confinement. Offscreen, Culkin feels that his real-life upbringing equipped him for a life of such solace.
 "Well, I'm the youngest of seven," Culkin says, beside his costar, Stephen Graham . "So I was often locked in closets and because of this, I never get bored. I'm very happy with my own thoughts, and I could just sit for hours and think. So, a silver lining to being bullied as a child."
 "You do know that's going to be the meme that's taken from this whole thing," Graham, 53, jokes, making his costar chuckle. "Rory Culkin says, 'I was often locked in closets as a child.'"
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "But I'm better because of it," Culkin says.
 NEW YORK, NEW YORK - OCTOBER 20: Rory Culkin attends Apple's "Nocturne" New York Premiere at Regal Union Square on October 20, 2026 in New York City. (Photo by Theo Wargo/Getty Images) Rory Culkin, 37, rounds out Christopher "Kit" Culkin and Patricia Brentrup's brood. During their decades-long relationship, they welcomed five sons and two daughters: Shane, 50; Dakota, who died in 2008 at 29 years old; Macaulay , 46; Kieran , 44; Quinn, 41 and Christian, 39.
 When asked who trapped Rory Culkin in the closet, he says, "Mostly the sisters."
 "The parents love the baby. The other siblings, when Mom leaves, you're going to…" Culkin trails off while raising his hand and laughing.
 Quinn Culkin, far left, Seth Green, Rory Culkin, Macaulay Culkin, Brenda Song and Paris Jackson are present to celebrate Macaulay's Star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on Dec. 1, 2023 in Hollywood, California. In "Nocturne" (Fridays on Apple TV), an adaptation of Lars Kepler's novel "The Sandman," Emmy Award-winning actor Graham portrays the murderous Jurek Walter, being investigated by retired detective Jonah Lynn ( Liev Schreiber ) and undercover FBI agent Saga Bauer ( Zazie Beetz ). Meanwhile, Culkin plays Karl, the nurse assigned to watch over Walter in the mental institution.
 Advertisement Advertisement Culkin says he took inspiration for his character from his younger self.
 "My 10-year-old self was my reference, just to be honest," he says, "heart on your sleeve and having a hard time showing the hurt on your face when someone hurts your feelings. So I just try to maintain this childlike purity, I suppose."
 As for Graham, he prepared for his role in the 10-episode series by watching dozens of documentaries about serial killers with his wife, actress Hannah Walters, "for about two weeks."
 "A lovely time," Graham says of their documentary binge watch. "We do have popcorn occasionally, but it was mostly crisps and Maltesers, and we'd sit and watch all of these serial killers."
 Liev Schreiber, left, with his "Nocturne" costars Zazie Beetz and Stephen Graham, at the series' New York premiere on Oct. 20, 2026. Though Culkin is part of a famous family, he says he and his siblings have "never really discussed" their work.
 Advertisement Advertisement "When we were younger, we were too busy just talking about X-Men or whatever," he says, noting that Macaulay has been "encouraging."
 "If we ever did talk about our careers, it was my brother reassuring me like, 'No, you're good s---. You're onto something,'" Rory Culkin says.
 "We're all busy and parents now," he adds. (He and cinematographer Kate Arizmendi welcomed daughter Havoc Moon in May.) "And we don't even talk about parenthood all that much really… Their advice was, 'You'll figure it out. We did.' And it was actually great advice. Your instincts will kick in, and you'll know what to do."
 Stars are bringing new bundles of joy into the world in 2026. Scroll through to see the celebrities who have welcomed babies this year.
 Jamie Foxx , 58, and girlfriend Alyce Huckstepp, 31, have welcomed their first child together, USA TODAY learned. People was the first to report the news Nov. 4.
The baby's sex and birth date have not been disclosed. The Oscar-winning actor is also father to daughters Corinne, 32, and Anelise, 18. 
Foxx and Huckstepp previously announced they were expecting in May. (Charley Gallay/Getty Images for Netflix; Sam Tabone/Getty Images) "Booksmart" star Beanie Feldstein revealed in an interview with People published Nov. 4 that she and her producer wife Bonnie-Chance Roberts welcomed their first child, a daughter, over the summer. The couple previously announced they were expecting in a May 4 Instagram post.
"She is genuinely beyond my wildest dreams. I really did dream her,” Feldstein said. “I always wanted to be a mom, and I always wanted a daughter. I look at her every day, and I’m like, ‘You’re just beyond anything I could have even tried to imagine.'" (Jamie McCarthy, Getty Images) "Call Her Daddy" podcast host Alex Cooper and her husband, Matt Kaplan, welcomed their first baby on Oct. 20.
The couple announced the news on Instagram with a photo of the newborn and a blue heart emoji. The couple did not reveal the baby's name.
Cooper and Kaplan, who married in Mexico in 2024, announced the pregnancy in May. (Noam Galai, Getty Images for YouTube) "Harry Potter" star Bonnie Wright is officially a mom of two! The actress, who played Ginny Weasley in the "Harry Potter" films, confirmed the birth of her second child in an Instagram post on Oct. 17.
"Say hello to our son Aster Sky Wright Lococo born at home on the 28th September," she wrote, adding that he was "named after the star shaped flower."
Wright and her husband. Andrew Lococo, also share a son, Elio, who was born in 2023.
"Our little star has been showered in love by his big brother Elio," Wright said. "Thank you universe for my loving bundle of boys!" (Jesse Grant, Getty Images for the Environment) Kaley Cuoco and fiancé Tom Pelphrey welcomed their second child , daughter Philomena Carmine Bobby Pelphrey, on Oct. 12. The "Big Bang Theory" alumna announced the birth on Instagram Oct. 14, writing, "Family officially complete."
The newborn joins big sister Matilda, 3; Cuoco and Pelphrey went public with their relationship in May 2022 and got engaged in August 2024. (Monica Schipper, Getty Images) Olivia Culpo and Christian McCaffrey are officially parents of two! The model, 34, and the the San Francisco 49ers running back, 30, have welcomed their second child together.
The couple shared the news in a joint Instagram post on Oct. 10, which revealed the newborn's name is Roman Augustus McCaffrey. He was born on Sept. 29.
Culpo and McCaffrey welcomed their first child together, Colette, in 2025. (Ethan Miller, Getty Images) Barbara Palvin and Dylan Sprouse are officially parents to a baby girl. The couple announced the birth of their first child in a joint Sept. 28 Instagram post featuring a photo of them and the newborn in matching Los Angeles Dodgers jerseys.
"We took Labor Day literally this year 👼🏻," they wrote in the caption, appearing to hint at their daughter's birthday. (SAMEER AL-DOUMY, AFP via Getty Images) After teasing the news in a trailer for his album "QRÖMELIFE," Quavo confirmed in a Complex interview posted Sept. 29 that he's now a "proud" dad, having welcomed a daughter.
"It's a blessing that God gave me," the Migos rapper said. "It's a whole new state [of being]. It brings joy to me. It brings a new reason why I'm doing this. It brings a new hunger, a new fire, to me."
 (Aurore Marechal, Getty Images) Jesse Williams got creative in alluding to himself and Alejandra Onieva welcoming their first child together. In a Sept. 28 Instagram carousel , the "Grey's Anatomy" alumnus reenacted a scene from Spike Lee’s "Do the Right Thing" as he reached into the fridge for a baby bottle while demanding that his Spanish partner speak English in front of their child.
Williams shares two children with his ex-wife, Aryn Drake-Lee.
 (Emma McIntyre, Getty Images for GQ) Taylor Lautner , left, and wife Tay Lautner have welcomed their first child. 
The “Twilight” star, 34, and the new mom, 29, revealed the arrival of their daughter, Lennon Taylor Lautner, in a joint Instagram post Sept. 23. The couple, who announced they were expecting in March, said Lennon was born Sept. 16. 
“One week loving our sweet little Lenny🤍 Lennon Taylor Lautner🎀 9.16.2026,” they captioned the post.
 (Kevin Winter, Getty Images) Millie Bobby Brown and Jake Bongiovi welcomed their second child via adoption, a source confirmed to People. The news comes just over a year after the lovebirds, who married in May 2024, announced in August 2025 that they had adopted a baby girl.
“This summer we welcomed our sweet baby girl through adoption," the "Stranger Things" actress wrote on Instagram at the time. "We are beyond excited to embark on this beautiful next chapter of parenthood in both peace and privacy. And then there were 3.”
 (Cindy Ord, Getty Images) Lena Dunham and her husband, Luis Felber , are now a family of three. The couple, who have been married since 2021 , welcomed a baby girl via surrogate, the actress revealed in a Vogue op-ed on Sept. 16.
The " Girls " creator recounted the emotional surrogacy journey, which came after 12 years of fertility issues. She recalled how she greeted her new baby: "You look nothing like I thought you would, but exactly right."
 (Joe Maher, Getty Images) Sean Ono Lennon has his own "little darling" now. 
The Grammy-winning musician, son of Beatles rocker John Lennon and singer-songwriter Yoko Ono, revealed he welcomed his first child with partner Charlotte Kemp Muhl in a Sept. 1 social media post. The birth also marks the first grandchild for the late John Lennon, who was fatally shot in 1980.
 (Michael Loccisano, Getty Images for Tribeca Festiva) Diplo has let the cat out of the bag on his newest addition.
The Grammy-winning producer confirmed he recently welcomed a fourth child in an Instagram post Aug. 14. The post, which featured several photos from Diplo's family trip to Peru, included a lightly redacted photo of his baby girl.
"My daughter celebrated her first birthday with llamas wearing sunglasses," Diplo wrote. "[Son] Lazer couldn't find Peru on a map a week ago and walked out of the airport in a poncho and an alpaca hat looking like he'd been selling ayahuasca to backpackers. Watching your kid become someone new in real time is the whole thing."
 (Matt Winkelmeyer, Getty Images for Netflix) "The McBee Dynasty: Real American Cowboys" stars Cole McBee and Kacie Adkinson welcomed their second child together.
The couple introduced their daughter, Tate Colette McBee, to the world in an Instagram post shared Aug. 5.
"Blair is the best big sister! We are so thankful for our two perfect, healthy girls!" they captioned the family photo.
 (Paul Andrews / Bravo) Sebastian Stan and Annabelle Wallis are reportedly first-time parents. The "Captain America: The Winter Soldier" star and "Annabelle" actress welcomed a baby in July, TMZ and People reported Aug. 3. Representatives for the couple did not respond to USA TODAY's request for comment. 
 (Neilson Barnard, Getty Images) Aubrey Plaza and Christopher Abbott reportedly welcomed their first child together in late July, TMZ reported. A representative for the "Parks and Recreation" alumna confirmed the baby news to People back in April.
On Sept. 30, Plaza stepped out to support her partner at the New York City premiere of Netflix's "East of Eden," starring Abbott. It was her first red carpet appearance since becoming a new mom. (Dimitrios Kambouris Photo/Getty Images for Tony Awards Pro) "Teen Wolf" alum Dylan Sprayberry and his wife, Pruette Karl, have welcomed their first child, they announced in a July 22 Instagram post. The actor announced the news simply with a shot of the baby's hand holding onto Karl's shirt. "'As written.'
 #longlivesprayberry," he captioned the photo.
 (Jesse Grant, Getty Images for Paramount+) Marc Anthony , 57, and his wife, Nadia Ferreira, 27, have welcomed their second child together. The couple announced the arrival on Instagram on July 21, sharing a photo of themselves with their 2-year-old son, Marco, cradling his newborn sister, Myla.
The baby marks Anthony's eighth child. He also shares daughter Arianna, 32, and son Chase, 31, with ex-girlfriend Debbie Rosado; sons Cristian, 25, and Ryan, 22, with ex-wife Dayanara Torres; and twins Emme and Maximilian, 18, with ex-wife Jennifer Lopez.
 (Jason Koerner, Getty Images) The "Age of Attraction" cohosts Natalie Joy and Nick Viall welcomed twin daughters, Iris Parker and Dove Tomlin, on June 30, the couple confirmed to People magazine . The pair's little ones came after they experienced three pregnancy losses in 2025. "It's been an emotional journey starting with multiple miscarriages, but we are so grateful to have our rainbow babies," the couple told the outlet.
 (Roger Kisby, Getty Images for Netflix) Model Kimberly Stewart quietly welcomed a son in 2025 but didn't reveal this until a year later. 
The daughter of 81-year-old rocker Rod Stewart wished her son a happy first birthday on her Instagram Story in July 2026. The photo showed her son wearing a dark blue shirt and plaid shorts, sitting in a high chair surrounded by blue balloons. 
 (Charley Gallay / Getty Images) Melissa George revealed she welcomed her fourth son in an Instagram post on July 7, writing "from the maternity ward, straight into a Parisian heatwave (with a toddler…challenging) and now to an epic road trip through Provence and the Cǒte d’Azur." 
She made the announcement while sharing a carousel of photos, including one of her breastfeeding her newborn. She also has three other sons named Raphael, Solal (whom she shares with ex Jean David Blanc), and Lyor.
 (VALERY HACHE / AFP via Getty Images) Milo Ventimiglia and wife Jarah Mariano are now parents of two. On July 6, Mariano shared on Instagram that they'd welcomed Rock-Anthony Makoa Ventimiglia into their family and opened up about how "these last couple of weeks have been chaos, but in the best possible way."
They welcomed their son a year and a half after the birth of daughter Ke'ala Coral Ventimiglia .
 (Monica Schipper, Getty Images) "When Calls the Heart" stars Erin Krakow and Ben Rosenbaum are officially a family of three! The Hallmark actors revealed in a June 23 People feature that Krakow, 41, gave birth to their first child , a daughter, in "early April."
The news comes a year after the duo tied the knot in a surprise social media announcement.
 (Rodin Eckenroth, Getty Images for Hallmark) Latto has welcomed her first child with 21 Savage. She appeared to announce the birth of her baby in an Instagram video on May 18. The montage showed clips from throughout her pregnancy, including one of her at 37 weeks emotionally saying she is "so ready to meet my baby."
Latto subsequently confirmed she had given birth in an interview with Apple Music released on May 29. "Some days I'm better than others," she said in the interview. "I do know, now I can confidently say, no amount of money, help, anything, can avoid postpartum depression. It's inevitable."
 (Arturo Holmes, Getty Images for REFORM Alliance) Josh Duhamel and Audra Mari confirmed they welcomed their second child together on May 16.
"Our baby girl is here 🤍," Mari wrote on Instagram, sharing that the baby's name is Rocca de Leon Duhamel.
Duhamel and Mari previously welcomed their son, Shepherd Lawrence Duhamel, in 2024. The actor also shares son Axl Jack, 12, with his ex-wife Fergie.
 (Jesse Grant, Getty Images for Paramount) Sienna Miller, 44, confirmed to E! News that she has welcomed her third child, her second with Oli Green.
Miller confirmed to E! she had already given birth. "It's happened," she said, adding, "I have a tiny baby next door. ... I feel slightly like stringing sentences together is challenging. I'm on very little sleep. But I'm madly in love with my baby." Miller already shares a 2-year-old daughter with Green, as well as a 13-year-old daughter, Marlowe, with ex Tom Sturridge. She revealed she was pregnant in December when she stepped out at the 2025 Fashion Awards in London . 
 (Joe Maher, Getty Images for BFC) "Pitch Perfect" star Rebel Wilson announced the birth of her second child, a baby girl, with wife Ramona Agruma on May 4. 
"Proud to announce the birth of our 2nd daughter Rose Estelle!" Wilson captioned an Instagram post . "What a gorgeous blessing to have another little girl! Now on May 4th it's now 4 of us!"
She added, "Ramona and I are feeling so incredibly grateful and blessed to grow our family, thank you everyone for all the well wishes."
 (Joe Maher, Getty Images) "Charlie's Angels" star Cameron Diaz and Good Charlotte rocker Benji Madden announced the birth of their third child together, a son named Nautas Madden, on May 4.
"Cameron and I are Happy, Excited, and feeling so BLESSED to announce the birth of our third Child, Nautas Madden," Madden wrote on Instagram, adding, "We love life with our family- our kids are healthy&happy, and we are grateful!!!🙏🙏having a blast ❤️."
Diaz and Madden are also parents to daughter Raddix, 6, and son Cardinal, 2.
 (Dimitrios Kambouris, Getty Images for REFORM Alliance) Chris Brown welcomed his first child with model Jada Wallace, his fourth overall, the pair revealed in an Instagram post on April 26. Neither Wallace nor Brown confirmed the baby's name or sex.
"Purest love 💛," Wallace wrote alongside a black-and-white maternity photo of herself. The last photo in the post showed a close-up shot of the newborn being bottle fed.
 (Stephane Cardinale, Corbis via Getty Images) Justin Theroux , 54, confirmed on April 18 that he has welcomed his first child with wife Nicole Brydon Bloom.
"He's here 🕊️ we are so in love," the couple captioned a joint Instagram post showing "The Leftovers" star cuddling with the baby boy.
Theroux and Bloom have been married since March 2025. The two actors met through a mutual friend.
 (Theo Wargo, Getty Images) Eddie Murphy's son Eric Murphy has welcomed his first child with Jasmin Lawrence, daughter of Martin Lawrence.
Eddie Murphy shared the news while speaking with E! at his American Film Institute Life Achievement Award ceremony on April 18.
"They just had a baby girl," the "Coming to America" star said. "They just had her two weeks ago, or a week ago. Yeah, Ari Skye."
Eric Murphy and Jasmin Lawrence confirmed their relationship in 2021, and they tied the knot in 2025. The couple met through Jasmin Lawrence's uncle.
 (Leon Bennett, Getty Images) Hailee Steinfeld announced on April 2 that she has welcomed her first child with husband Josh Allen.
In Steinfeld's "Beau Society" newsletter, the couple shared that "our baby girl has arrived," adding, "We're feeling incredibly grateful and blessed and savouring these early moments. Thank you so much for the love and well wishes." The Oscar-nominated actress and the Buffalo Bills quarterback have been married since 2025.
 (MICHAEL TRAN, AFP via Getty Images) Elliot Grainge and Sofia Richie Grainge have added another bundle of joy to their growing family. "Henry Cecil Grainge 💙 03/18/26," Richie Grainge wrote in a March 25 Instagram post , which included a photo of a blue onesie-donning newborn in the lap of their daughter, Eloise.
"Loves of my life," she added.
 (Monica Schipper, Getty Images) Carly Rae Jepsen is a mom!
"Last 2 weeks have been the best of my life. Welcome to the world little one," the "Run Away with Me" singer shared on her Instagram story March 17. In the photo, she cuddled her newborn, who was wearing a spring-appropriate mint green set.
The baby is her first with Cole M.G.N., whom she married in October 2025. Their pregnancy announcement came a month later.
 (ANGELA WEISS, AFP via Getty Images) Jack Osbourne , son of heavy metal icon Ozzy Osbourne, announced on March 11 that he welcomed a baby girl: Ozzy Matilda Osbourne, named after his late father. 
This is Jack Osbourne's fifth child and second with his wife, Aree Osbourne. Ozzy Osbourne, the cofounder of Black Sabbath, died in July 2025 at age 76.
 (Charley Gallay, Getty Images for ALYST Health) Charles Melton is now officially a dad! The "May December" actor and "Riverdale" alum shared the news in a March 9 Instagram carousel that featured photos from "our family."
He and girlfriend Camille Summers-Valli, who'd previously shared her pregnancy in a Jan. 2 Instagram post , were seen cuddling up with the newborn in the portraits.
 (Kate Green, Getty Images) Alyssa Farah Griffin , cohost of "The View" and former White House strategic communications director, welcomed her first child with husband Justin Griffin on Feb. 10.
"We're overjoyed and so grateful for all the well wishes!" Griffin wrote on Instagram while confirming the birth of her son Justin Patrick Griffin Jr. The other hosts of "The View" offered their congratulations on the Feb. 11 episode, as Whoopi Goldberg told viewers that "both mom and baby are doing well," though "I'm sure they're tired."
 (Dave Kotinsky, Getty Images for Webby Awards) R&B singer Mario confirmed the birth of his first child with girlfriend Esmeralda Rios in an Instagram story on Monday, Jan. 26.
The "Let Me Love You" artist shared a selfie taken from a hospital and wrote, "Women are God's greatest creation cuz what I witness today was ONLY GODS work!" He added that he and Rios had welcomed a "healthy baby boy!" Mario previously confirmed he was expecting a child with Rios in August 2025, when he shared a photo of himself touching her baby bump. "It's a whole universe in there!" he wrote. "I can't wait."
 (UNIQUE NICOLE, AFP via Getty Images) Meghan Trainor announced on Jan. 20 that she and husband Daryl Sabara have welcomed their third child together via surrogacy. "Our baby girl Mikey Moon Trainor has finally made it to the world thanks to our incredible, superwoman surrogate," Trainor captioned a series of photos, including one of her holding her newborn daughter. 
She added, "We had endless conversations with our doctors in this journey and this was the safest way for us to be able to continue growing our family." Trainor and Sabara are already parents to Riley, 4, and Barry, 2. Trainor later told People magazine she wants "people to know that surrogacy is just another beautiful way to build a family" and is "not something to whisper about or judge."
 (VALERIE MACON, AFP via Getty Images) Singer Perrie Edwards welcomed her second child with partner Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain, she announced in a Jan. 17 Instagram post.
"Alanis Valentine 💕," she captioned a photo showing the newborn being held. The couple previously welcomed their first child, a boy, in August 2021.
 (Jeff Spicer, Getty Images) Dom Natale and Lo Bosworth welcomed their baby girl Nelle, announcing the birth in a Jan. 15 Instagram post .
"She started the year by surprising us two weeks early, but really, she was right on time. Our teeny one is named for her Oma and already so loved," Bosworth wrote. 
 (Astrid Stawiarz / Getty Images) Broadway actress Jennifer Damiano confirmed she welcomed a child with "The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel" star Michael Zegen on Jan. 9.
"Our beautiful baby girl, Oona Rose Zegen, was born January 3rd, 2026 under a full moon in New York City. It’s been nice knowing ya!" she wrote . The news came about a year after Damiano and Zegen tied the knot in January 2025.
 (Dimitrios Kambouris, Getty Images for CNN/WBD) Meghan McCain, daughter of late Sen. John McCain and former cohost of "The View," welcomed her third child with husband Ben Domenech on Jan. 2. 
"We are all blissed out over the moon," she wrote on Instagram . "Everyone is happy, healthy and exhausted." She added, "Our family is officially a party of 5." McCain and Domenech's family also includes daughters Liberty, 5, and Clover, 3.
 (Jamie McCarthy, Getty Images) Stars who welcomed babies in 2026 – Jamie Foxx, Beanie Feldstein, more
 1 of 44 Stars are bringing new bundles of joy into the world in 2026. Scroll through to see the celebrities who have welcomed babies this year.
 Jamie Foxx , 58, and girlfriend Alyce Huckstepp, 31, have welcomed their first child together, USA TODAY learned. People was the first to report the news Nov. 4.
The baby's sex and birth date have not been disclosed. The Oscar-winning actor is also father to daughters Corinne, 32, and Anelise, 18. 
Foxx and Huckstepp previously announced they were expecting in May. (Charley Gallay/Getty Images for Netflix; Sam Tabone/Getty Images) In contrast, Beetz, who debuted her baby bump in a midriff-baring two-piece at the series' New York premiere on Oct. 20, says she's soliciting the wisdom of others.
 Advertisement Advertisement "I am asking for the advice," she says beside Schreiber, father to Alexander aka "Sasha," 19; Kai, 17 and Hazel, 3.
 "That experience is so profoundly personal," Schreiber, 59, says. "The only thing I would ever say to anyone is block out the first three months after the baby is born. They're just for you. They're just for the three of you. It's so special. I'm so excited for her."
 "I know it's cliche, but it really is the blessing I've been hoping for for so long," Beetz, 35, says, noting that she and her husband, actor David Rysdahl, have "been really cherishing every moment."
